patches.before: from nemo_relay import plugin as plugin_module
patches.after: from standalone import relay_plugin as plugin_module

preserved: Strict catalog/config/rate/tier schemas; per-provider alias uniqueness and ASCII case normalization
Inline/file snapshots in source precedence order; response paths never read files or contact pricing services
Explicit/default provider routing, terminal model fallback and ordered full-request inclusive threshold tiers
Included/separate prompt-cache accounting, unpriced cache components without fabricated totals, zero usage and reserved non-token units
f64 arithmetic with Rust half-away rounding to twelve decimal places and native provider-reported currency/cost precedence
OpenAI Chat/Responses and Anthropic canonical prompt/completion/cache/uncached usage, saturating iteration sums and cross-model iteration refusal
Activation owns a single process-wide resolver and removes it when closed; existing model data and provider usage are unmodified
limitations: No implicit pricing catalog, live-price discovery or currency conversion is supplied by the original component or this port.
Native lock poisoning has no corresponding normal Python runtime failure; the qualified resolver uses an owned RLock.

Complete provider response normalization, adaptive cost projection and all trace/ATIF exporter attributes remain separately tracked; these fixtures establish catalog/usage/cost equality for the consumed provider surfaces.
